goal: Establish the pure immutable release, Active Season Manifest, community election, shadow comparison and promotion policy contracts required before PostgreSQL release storage or runtime cutover.
userValue: Gear and community data can be validated as one coherent current-season release before it becomes public, preventing mixed revisions, illegal winners and silent fallback.
nonGoals: No database migration, release write or active pointer in Slice 4A
No browse, Resolver, Profile or frontend runtime cutover
No scheduled refresh service or timer
No public baseline, recommendation, DPS comparison or BiS behavior
No Phase 5 SimC job or Worker
No dependency installation or unapproved local download

mustChange: one pure release domain with canonical hash-addressed Gear and Community Release contracts
formal Active Season Manifest validation and release-binding rules
per-spec observed candidate election with winner, standby and rejected roles
40-spec shadow diff and risk-classified promotion decisions
focused domain tests plus owner map, runbook, roadmap and Strict evidence
mustNotChange: active PostgreSQL staging tables and runtime readers
canonical Resolver and Evidence Ledger ownership
active gear workbench behavior and legacy endpoint compatibility
PostgreSQL-only runtime and deploy async-sync default
evidenceRequired: TDD proof for canonical release IDs, immutability and manifest bindings
illegal, stale, source-invalid and mixed-release election rejection
deterministic winner/standby behavior and no public baseline leakage
shadow diff and promotion/rollback decision coverage
backend/full verification, local CR, exact-head CI and dormant candidate runtime parity

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_release.py over the existing pure gear_resolver.py

engineeringHealth.reason: Slice 4A adds one dependency-free policy boundary before any schema or runtime integration and reuses the canonical Resolver instead of duplicating legality facts.

acceptanceEvidence: Python compile, purity/static boundary review and git diff --check
candidate runtime parity with no active import or behavior claim

decisionLog.decision: Use five Phase 4 Slices: pure contracts, immutable PostgreSQL registry and legacy import, shadow readers, atomic manifest cutover, then scheduled candidate refresh.
Mutable sync tables remain staging; public readers will use immutable release-scoped rows after cutover.
The first observed Community Release is legacy-import-r0 but every winner must re-pass the current Resolver against its exact Gear Release.
Promotion and rollback move one manifest pointer; sealed release content is never edited.
